metaDescription: Shop custom set in sleeve nursing scrubs for your team. Bulk orders with embroidery. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Set in sleeve construction creates a clean, professional shoulder line that stays in place during long shifts. Unlike raglan or drop sleeves, set in sleeves offer a tailored fit that resists bunching under lab coats. For healthcare facilities ordering branded scrubs, this sleeve style provides a polished look that holds up to frequent washing. Decorate with left-chest embroidery or screen-printed logos for a crisp, lasting impression.
heroAltText: Custom set in sleeve nursing scrubs with embroidered logo on chest, tailored fit
